game_title: Divide Or Floor – Crater Lake Edge Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge, the edge of a glowing crater: the lava scout must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split cooling flasks evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge: the edge of a glowing crater
core_gameplay_loop: In Crater Lake Edge, repeat each round: Pick / or // to split cooling flasks evenly among allies without leaving fractions. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the share value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 6 consecutive correct decisions about share to power up the lava scout and open the smelter.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 3 (intro tier): Divide Or Floor
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Crater Lake Edge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how share changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against lava imps in Crater Lake Edge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 6.
